replication.target_description: ERN amplitude versus liberalism/conservatism, Spearman rank correlations: self-evaluation and validated orientation are separate candidate tests.

es.quote: The Spearman’s rank correlation coefficient between ERN ... and L/C orientation did not show any significant connection ... either for the values determined by self-evaluation (ρ = −0.11, ... p = 0.297) or for the validated values (ρ = −0.01, p = 0.910)

p.quote: The Spearman’s rank correlation coefficient between ERN ... and L/C orientation did not show any significant connection ... either for the values determined by self-evaluation (ρ = −0.11, ... p = 0.297) or for the validated values (ρ = −0.01, p = 0.910)

reported_success.quote: we found no relationship between the ERN or ... N2 NoGo and L/C orientation based on the self-evaluation in the ... larger homogenous cohort of 100 participants.

notes: Identity verified from the supplied full nine-page primary research text: title Neural Correlates of Liberalism and Conservatism in a Post-communist Country; Jan Kremláček, Daniel Musil, Jana Langrová and Martin Palecek; ORIGINAL RESEARCH; published 12 April 2019; DOI 10.3389/fnhum.2019.00119. These match the neutral replication reference. No PDF was supplied; no rendering or acquisition performed. Original side and replication n are unassigned placeholders. The neutral description and p. 6 locator identify the neural outcome but do not specify self-evaluation versus validated L/C orientation. Both tests are reported; no unique row-to-test correspondence can be established from the allowed input. Candidates (not selected): Self-evaluation: Spearman ρ = −0.11, p = 0.297 (exact). Validated orientation: Spearman ρ = −0.01, p = 0.910 (exact). Authors explicitly report no relationship for both ERN and N2 NoGo; the reported_success verdict is independently established despite ambiguity between the two orientation measures. No sample N or effect-size conversion was derived.
